item.title: 3 brothers of Iraqi descent arrested in Oslo for allegedly 'terror bombing' of US Embassy
item.summary: Three Norwegian brothers of Iraqi origin were arrested for allegedly bombing the U.S. Embass in Oslo. No injuries were reported in Sunday's explosive attack.

item.title: FIFA president says Trump reiterated Iran 'welcome to compete' at World Cup in US amid Middle East conflict
item.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino said President Donald Trump “reiterated" to him that Iran's soccer team is welcome at 2026 World Cup in US, despite ongoing the Middle East conflict.

item.title: CNN botches New York terrorist attack coverage, forced to issue multiple corrections
item.summary: CNN has had a rough week covering the alleged ISIS-inspired terror attack in New York City, issuing a pair of embarrassing apologies after facing significant online backlash.

item.title: 'You can cry about it': Tempers flare in Senate as DHS shutdown debate erupts, stalemate digs deeper
item.summary: Neither side is close to a deal to end the DHS shutdown, which entered its 26th day on Wednesday. Republicans want a temporary funding extension, while Democrats want to carve out ICE.

item.title: Trump admin responds after SJSU sues to challenge Title IX investigation into transgender volleyball scandal
item.summary: Federal officials threatened funding cuts to SJSU after university refuses to negotiate resolution over alleged Title IX violations in volleyball program.

item.title: Fanatics release full participant list filled with NFL stars for Tom Brady-backed Flag Football Classic
item.summary: Fanatics officially announced its full participant list for their inaugural Flag Football Classic, including Tom Brady, Jayden Daniels, Jalen Hurts and many more NFL stars.

item.title: Alleged hazing death tied to secretive rush night ignites arrests and frat reckoning
item.summary: College freshman allegedly dies from alcohol poisoning during fraternity hazing at Northern Arizona University, prompting arrests and chapter shutdown.

item.title: Husband accused of killing wife says he heard laughter, then screams before finding her dying
item.summary: Ohio man Kyle Long charged with murdering wife Rachel after investigation into her stabbing death. She suffered 17 wounds despite his suicide claims, authorities said.

item.title: Woman allegedly touches passengers' faces, then punches elderly travelers during Caribbean flight
item.summary: An Alabama woman allegedly assaulted elderly passengers during a mid-air meltdown on a Frontier flight, forcing an emergency landing in Miami after the violent outburst.

item.title: Minnesota human services officials skip fraud hearing as Walz promises reform
item.summary: Minnesota human services officials skip fraud hearing as frustrated lawmakers demand accountability. Gov. Walz promises reform amid ongoing fraud concerns.
